# Test Ooze

- **Type:** Large Ooze, Unaligned

- **Armor Class:** 8
- **Hit Points:** 52 (7d10 + 14)
- **Speed:** 20 ft., Climb 20 ft.
- **Initiative**: -2 (8)

|STAT|SCORE|MOD|SAVE|
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| STR | 15 | +2 | +2 |
| DEX | 6 | -2 | -2 |
| CON | 14 | +2 | +5 |
| INT | 2 | -4 | -4 |
| WIS | 6 | -2 | -2 |
| CHA | 1 | -5 | -5 |

- **Resistances**: Acid
- **Immunities**: Lightning, Slashing; Charmed, Prone
- **Senses**: blindsight 60 ft.; Passive Perception 8
- **CR** 2 (XP 450; PB +2)

## Traits

***Amorphous.*** The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

## Actions

***Multiattack.*** The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

***Pseudopod.*** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
